notes.title: Getting to know the Characters of "SEX COACH: HOT YOGA"
notes.content:
Hello, community! 🌟

We want to tell you about one of the most exciting characters in our new game - Rachel Fierce!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/7349c53c6ec2c77d64831b23c9a5d8807b96cdbe.png[/img]
So, meet Rachel - young, executive, and always surprising you with her energy. She is an administrator at the "Dream Body" fitness club! 💪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/36474bb2a03b89e91c35cc7375efcc71457d512a.png[/img]
There is something incredible about her attitude toward work. She not only runs the club but also creates an atmosphere where everyone can feel comfortable and motivated. Thanks to her outspoken nature and ability to speak the truth to the face, Rachel has won the trust of the club manager Thelma.

As for the "posers" who take pictures of their beauty in the gym mirrors, Rachel does not understand this fiction at all. She believes that true success is the result of hard work and inner strength, not just showmanship.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/d49e0cd85e53d7dd4c25cdd2970402d13b6201b7.jpg[/img]
And another interesting fact is that Rachel is not personally interested in sports, but thanks to her work, the fitness club is becoming a real oasis for those who value a healthy lifestyle.

notes.title: Getting to Know the Characters of "SEX COACH: HOT YOGA"
notes.content:
Adam Rice is a young man full of energy and passion. Ambitious, impressionable, and trusting, he is always ready for adventure. He loves risk, classical music, and workouts where he can hone his skills in various poses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/fb4c2de9118350a12cc4c7633f8c929e0f58c9f7.png[/img]
The melodies of classical music resonate in his life, giving each moment a special atmosphere. His days are filled with music that inspires him to new achievements.

Adam dedicates a lot of time to training, striving for perfection in various poses. For him, it's not just an activity but a way of self-expression and achieving harmony.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/4b606fce76e25c83c30cc6c9c0a41b98b7989dc0.png[/img]
Engaging in spiritual practices, he found in yoga the perfect way to balance his passionate temperament. Yoga, for Adam, is not just physical activity but a way to achieve inner harmony.

notes.title: Preview of the story of Sex Coach: Hot Yoga
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

As requested by the community, We wish to share small part of the story of Sex Coach: Hot Yoga. 
This will hopefully answer some of your questions and give a better understanding of where the project is headed.
Sex Coach: Hot Yoga full story is set to 9 days and will feature multiple endings, plot twists and romance scenes depending on your choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/9ab26b61ee85108d308cf738944685aa6e3e258b.png[/img]
You will find an interesting story about the incredible adventures of the protagonist, who gets a job in the incredible fitness club "Dream body", not only in scale but also in prestige. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/40c0808424d53572575cf97bb4a00faa062a82ce.png[/img]
A young man gets acquainted with different characters (club employees, customers), each of whom has his own complicated history - the hero may find himself drawn into unpleasant circumstances that can affect the reputation in the club.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44201255/d5947935e6f8a9d06eb8b4780d35cff13d6e6e0d.png[/img]
